comment: The ffmpeg builds Clipper ships, pinned to an exact versioned file and its sha256. Read by .erb/scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js (CI and local packaging) and written into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. All four are GPL builds (libx264), which is why the notice offers the source. To change one: download the new file, check it against the publisher's own checksum, put the new version, url and sha256 here, run the codec check (npm run fetch:ffmpeg, then the 'Verify bundled binaries' CI step), and update THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Pins checked 2026-11-10: gyan.dev and johnvansickle.com publish the checksums noted in 'verifiedAgainst'; the macOS pins are the ones the release workflow already carried.

linux-x64.verifiedAgainst: md5 7fa72b652e19bf84c9461e332ea1cdf3, published as ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz.md5 when 7.0.2 was the release

win32-x64.verifiedAgainst: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip.sha256 (same value, 9.0.2 being the release); build details at https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
